story.sectionHeadline: Three reasons this honey is different.

chapters.title: Born on the wild coast.
chapters.body: Our single-origin honey is harvested from wild coastal landscapes along the Danish shoreline, untouched by pesticides and far from industry. Every jar carries the living character of the North Sea coast.

chapters.title: Architecture of flavour.
chapters.body: Bees engineer perfection: hexagonal chambers calibrated to the millimetre. We preserve what they create. Nothing added, nothing removed.

chapters.title: Raw. Unfiltered. Alive.
chapters.body: HONEY 56° honey is cold-extracted to preserve every enzyme, pollen grain, and antioxidant. What reaches you is exactly what the hive intended.

product.subtitle: 350g · Cold-extracted
product.limitedNote: Limited harvest: quantities are not replenished mid-season.

benefits.title: Living enzymes preserved
benefits.desc: Cold-extracted below 35°C to keep naturally occurring enzymes, antioxidants, and pollen intact.

benefits.title: Single-origin terroir
benefits.desc: Sourced from wild coastal apiaries along the Danish shoreline. No blending, no compromise.

benefits.title: Zero additives. Always.
benefits.desc: No heat treatment, no added sugars, no preservatives. What you receive is exactly what the bees made.

benefits.title: Ethical beekeeping
benefits.desc: Our partner apiaries follow regenerative practices: bees are never harmed and hives are never over-extracted.

reviews.quote: The most extraordinary honey I have ever tasted. The floral complexity is unlike anything from a supermarket shelf. Nothing else comes close.
reviews.author: Isabelle M.

reviews.quote: I buy this for my restaurant's cheese board. Guests consistently ask about it. The terroir comes through — you can taste the meadow.
reviews.author: Marco F.

reviews.quote: We've been gifting HONEY 56° at Christmas for three years running. The presentation alone justifies the price, but the taste is what makes customers return.
reviews.author: Charlotte R.

reviews.quote: As a nutritional therapist, I recommend this to all my clients. Raw, unfiltered, and the enzyme profile is exceptional. This is honey the way it should be.
reviews.author: Dr. Priya N.

reviews.quote: Silky, warm, with notes of lavender and something almost caramel. Spread on sourdough in the morning this is my favourite ritual.
reviews.author: Thomas B.

cta.body: Each harvest is finite. When the 2026 batch sells out, the next won't arrive until the following season. Reserve yours now.
